# [TASK] Create GitHub Templates & Workflows

## Task
Set up the GitHub issue and pull request templates, the two CI workflows,
the project automation workflow, and Dependabot.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] The four issue templates (epic, user-story, task, bug) and the pull
      request template exist
      (`ProjectStructureTest.issueAndPullRequestTemplatesExist`)
- [x] `backend-ci.yml` and `frontend-ci.yml` trigger on push
      (`ProjectStructureTest.continuousIntegrationWorkflowsTriggerOnPush`)
- [x] `project-automation.yml` exists
      (`ProjectStructureTest.continuousIntegrationWorkflowsTriggerOnPush`)
- [x] Dependabot covers gradle, npm, github-actions and docker
      (`ProjectStructureTest.dependabotCoversTheFourEcosystems`)
- [x] Backend CI runs build, test, coverage and static analysis on every
      push (`gh run list --workflow=backend-ci.yml`)

## Estimate
**Hours:** 3

## Notes
The last criterion recorded CI being green on 2025-11-14. That said nothing
about later runs, and CI has been red since: #107, #109 and #161. Replaced
with the command that reports current run status.

Both workflows are path-filtered, so a change outside `backend/` or
`frontend/` does not trigger them.
